BiblicalUsage: Wisdom delivers the young man from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaketh froward things. The worthless man devises mischief continually, sowing discord. The mouth of the just brings forth wisdom, but the froward tongue shall be cut out, and Moses says of a faithless generation, they are children in whom is no faith, and the Lord will hide His face from them. The word is perversity, fraud: speech twisted, and a heart turned aside.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that perversity begins in the mouth and ends in the heart. I believe Proverbs is right to put wisdom first: the delivery from froward speech is not willpower but wisdom, and wisdom is a Person to receive.
